notes:
- Added a dedicated **JPEG files only** project type for JPEG-only shoots. JPEG-only projects ignore RAW files, do not show RAW matching issues, and export selected JPEG originals directly into `SELECTS` rather than `SELECTS/JPG`.
- JPEG-only projects retain the same safe destination model: `SELECTS` can stay beside the source or live on another connected drive/folder. Source JPEGs remain copy-only and are never moved, renamed, overwritten or deleted.
- Added optional software update checks backed by a public GitHub release manifest. Automatic checks are user-controllable, run at most once per day, fail silently when offline, and never block local culling/export work.
- Added a manual **Check for Updates** control in Settings and an update-available dialog with **Later** / **Download Update**. Download Update opens the platform-specific public GitHub release asset in the default browser; Selects does not silently download or install updates.
- Added strict update-manifest validation: semantic version comparison, HTTPS-only release links and GitHub host allow-listing.
- Updated the Privacy Notice to v1.1 to disclose the optional GitHub update request and clarify that photographs, project data, decisions and usage analytics are not intentionally included.
- Added four core tests for JPEG-only scan/export/destination behaviour and deterministic update-manifest validation, bringing the suite to 37 scenarios.
